name: anki-sync
description: Sync flashcards from Obsidian to Anki

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../typst-math/crates/typst-math-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --release && sed -i "s/new URL('typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm', import.meta.url)/'typst_math_wasm_bg.wasm'/g" pkg/typst_math_wasm.js && cd ../../../anki-sync/crates/anki-sync-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --release && sed -i "s/new URL('anki_sync_wasm_bg.wasm', import.meta.url)/'anki_sync_wasm_bg.wasm'/g" pkg/anki_sync_wasm.js
